title: Looker Studio Automation - Next Steps Handoff

symptom_reported_by_user.duplication: Right panel shows many duplicated datasources (e.g., repeated ls_v_02_top_10_brands_yesterday).
symptom_reported_by_user.root_concern: Current scripts are not idempotent; reruns keep adding pages/charts/datasources.

goal.primary: Find correct, scalable approach to create/configure multiple charts/pages in a single official Looker Studio report without duplication on reruns.
secondary: Document the official/idiomatic capabilities (Linking API vs Looker Studio API vs unsupported chart CRUD).
Identify in-repo scripts causing duplication and why.
Propose a source-of-truth workflow that is idempotent (repeatable without creating duplicates).

execution_plan_v3.label: Plan 3 - Research and analysis only (no edits)

phase_0_prechecks.action: Confirm current OpenCode model and available antigravity Gemini models
phase_0_prechecks.success: Model list includes antigravity-gemini-3-flash and antigravity-gemini-3-pro

phase_0_prechecks.action: Confirm the official report is accessible in browser (manual user check)
phase_0_prechecks.how: User opens official edit_url and confirms it loads

focus: Where datasources are added (e.g., 'Add data' -> BigQuery)
Any existence checks (and whether they are reliable)
phase_1_repo_audit.deliverable: A short map: file -> function -> operation type (page/chart/datasource)

analysis_prompts: Which scripts are non-idempotent by design (always add page/chart)?
Which scripts attempt idempotency using brittle text checks?
Which loops re-run without guards (e.g., for specs)?
phase_1_repo_audit.deliverable: A ranked list of duplication causes, each with code references

phase_2_official_capabilities_research.deliverable: What is supported: Linking API for report creation + Looker Studio API for asset management; what is NOT supported: full report/chart CRUD

phase_2_official_capabilities_research.action: Clarify datasource duplication rules (Create vs Add) and alias usage
phase_2_official_capabilities_research.deliverable: Guidelines for avoiding duplicated datasources when using Linking API

phase_3_proposed_correct_workflow.action: Propose a stable workflow to scale charts without duplication

options.name: Template-per-chart + Linking API per chart
cons: Many assets if user clicks Edit and share
Harder to maintain as one official report with many pages

options.name: Single official report, scripted idempotent updates
cons: Requires UI automation; must implement strict idempotency and robust selectors

phase_3_proposed_correct_workflow.deliverable: Recommendation + exact invariants for idempotency (page naming, chart tagging, datasource naming)
A minimal set of stable identifiers the automation can search for reliably

deliverables: A follow-up JSON plan for implementation (only after user approves)

anti_patterns_to_avoid: Using page.get_by_text(view_table) to detect existing datasource (false positives)
Rerunning scripts that always click 'Add page' or 'Add data' without dedup guards
Copy/paste loops that do not mark created chart objects with unique tags
